audience: merchants and dispatch teams that book deliveries with Burq in the US and Canada

useCases.title: Check coverage and the fee before quoting a customer
useCases.text: Check whether Burq can deliver between a pickup and a drop-off address. Estimate the fee from ZIP codes and item size, in cents.

useCases.title: Track the status of an order
useCases.text: Read the latest state of one order, with its pickup, drop-off and delivery status. Open its route to see the stop sequence.

useCases.title: Compare the quotes for a route
useCases.text: List the quotes from the latest quote run for a route. Open one quote to compare its cost, provider and pickup time.

useCases.title: Create orders, group them into a route and get quotes
useCases.text: Create delivery orders and group them into a route. Then start the route quotes. Nothing is booked with a courier yet.

useCases.title: Dispatch a route from a chosen quote
useCases.text: Dispatch a route from one of its quotes. In production this books a real courier and charges the account. Use a sandbox key to test.

useCases.title: Cancel an order or a whole route
useCases.text: Cancel the latest delivery of an order, or cancel a whole route. Order cancellation fails when the driver is already en route.
